# FIXTURE: bad-04 — verse ends with speech-intro verb (last token) WITHOUT לֵאמֹר
# The speech verb must be the LAST token of the verse's last cola
# Violation: speech-intro cross-verse pattern
# Rule: H10/cross-verse, pattern: speech-intro-cross-verse, REVIEW-REQUIRED
# Expected: ≥1 finding with pattern speech-intro-cross-verse

1:1
וַיָּקָם יוֹנָה וַיֹּאמֶר

1:2
מִי עָשָׂה זֹאת׃
